what: One screen without scroll, with several rooms (panels) stacked on top of each other. Every time wheel deltaY accumulates to 80 (the count restarts after a pause over 80ms), or on an arrow key, a 50px drag, or a dot press, the current room is pushed out to the opposite side and the next room slides in from the side over .65s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1). For .3s after a switch the wheel is discarded so an inertial wheel does not advance two steps. At 810px or below it pushes up and down

options.per: Wheel distance to advance one slot, default 80
options.lock: Time to ignore wheel input after flipping (sec), default .3
options.swipe: Distance to push with a finger (px), default 50
options.narrow: At or below this width (px) it pushes up and down, default 810
options.[data-fx-part=room]: Room — fills the frame completely and stacks on top
options.[data-fx-part=dot]: (if present) room dots — paired with the rooms in order, aria-current on the current room dot=true
options.fx:leave · fx:change: Frame detail when flipping starts and after it finishes { index, count } fires — hook text settling and video playback after entering the room here
options.fx:go: Frame detail { index } Shoot it and it goes to that room

note: Since it intercepts the wheel (preventDefault), use it only in one-screen rooms with no scroll. Where a panel uses the wheel separately (zoom steps etc.), set fxHandled on the event in that listener = Set to true and paging skips that roll. Finger swipes are not intercepted (touchmove is not blocked).
